item.tib: spyi spungs phywa tshe dmu yad kyi rten du gzug
item.coloph: stong rgyung la sogs mkhas pa mi bzhis mang mkhar lcags 'phrang bon phug tu/ yum sras lnga dang wer ze khri/ khyed la rgyal blon bod 'bangs gtad/ rgyal blon mu le kha thum/ bon 'di lnga brgya'i za mar dar rgyas shog (?) th+ya swa rgya1/ u ya ag tham/ mang mkhar brag nas he ru ka yis rnyed/ bkra shis par shog/
